definition: The ability to remain oriented and recover competent agency when facing an important situation that is novel, ambiguous, cross-domain, emotionally charged, time-constrained, or partly outside prior expertise.
anti_claim: No curriculum can make a person unsurprised by life. Novelty scenarios only test a subset of adaptive agency and must not displace knowledge, relationships, culture, craft, meaning, taste or stewardship.

scoring_dimensions.name: Situation classification
scoring_dimensions.question: What kind of problem is this, and which parts are technical, empirical, normative, relational, institutional, or existential?

scoring_dimensions.name: Stakes and triage
scoring_dimensions.question: What can cause irreversible harm soon, and what can wait?

scoring_dimensions.name: Uncertainty calibration
scoring_dimensions.question: What is known, unknown, assumed, contested, and time-sensitive?

scoring_dimensions.name: Knowledge mobilization
scoring_dimensions.question: Which existing models/skills apply, and where are their boundaries?

scoring_dimensions.name: Unknown-unknown detection
scoring_dimensions.question: What expertise, data, stakeholder, or failure mode might be missing from the frame?

scoring_dimensions.name: Learning velocity
scoring_dimensions.question: Can the learner acquire the missing domain knowledge quickly enough to improve the decision?

scoring_dimensions.name: Expertise and help-seeking
scoring_dimensions.question: Does the learner know when to escalate to qualified professionals or affected people?

scoring_dimensions.name: Reversibility and option value
scoring_dimensions.question: Does the learner preserve safe exits, redundancy, and future information where possible?

scoring_dimensions.name: Coordination and communication
scoring_dimensions.question: Can the learner align people, institutions, and AI tools without losing accountability?

scoring_dimensions.name: Ethics / rights / care
scoring_dimensions.question: Are vulnerable people, consent, rights, duties, and distributional effects recognized?

scoring_dimensions.name: Execution under pressure
scoring_dimensions.question: Can the learner actually carry out the chosen plan safely and adapt as conditions change?

scoring_dimensions.name: Post-outcome update
scoring_dimensions.question: Does the learner learn from the result, revise models, repair harm, and preserve the lesson?

scenario_families: Conflicting evidence, symptoms/diagnosis uncertainty, care navigation, time pressure; scoring must reward safe scope and professional escalation.
Income loss, debt, fraud, insurance, liquidity, caregiving or housing tradeoffs.
Trust, betrayal, consent/boundaries, grief, caregiving, family conflict, reconciliation or exit.
Power, water, transport, equipment, safety, logistics, repair-or-escalate decisions.
Role disappears, new technology changes skill value, learner must retrain and reorient.
Fabricated but persuasive sources, propaganda, deepfakes, conflicting experts, social pressure.
Rules, incentives and metrics diverge; whistleblowing, recourse, organizational responsibility.
Rights, law, public goods, legitimacy, disagreement, procedure and collective action.
Shortcutting, evaluator gaming, compromised provenance, privacy/security breach, goal misspecification.
Disaster, pollution, extreme weather, supply disruption, field-model mismatch.
No clean optimum; duties and harms conflict and loss is unavoidable.
A problem from a field not explicitly taught; learner receives limited time/resources to orient and learn.
Unfamiliar tradition, norm, language, aesthetic or historical frame makes default assumptions fail.
Unexpected high-upside opportunity with asymmetric uncertainty, commitments and opportunity costs.
Death, failure, identity disruption, success without purpose, or conflict among life commitments.

protocol.bank_creation: Curate scenarios after graph/version freeze. Use multiple independent curators and rotate banks so designers cannot teach to exact cases.
protocol.scoring: Use multi-rater analytic rubrics plus consequential outcome measures where possible; preserve qualitative examiner comments.
protocol.anti_goodhart: Do not publish the exact hidden bank. Publish construct/rubric families. Refresh cases and include decoys where formulaic checklists would fail.
protocol.success_pattern: No expectation of perfect answers. Strong performance means appropriate orientation, calibrated uncertainty, robust process, safe action, intelligent escalation, and learning.

role: One adversarial stress-test within broad human formation; not the Obelisk telos.
